conditionalFacts: The five conditional OBJECT_FIELD observations concern model_attempt_id, model_invocation_id and runtime_request_id. Their identity relationships are intentionally not imported; destination signing and correlation rules are independent.

This zero-bill profile has no cost or authoritative financial accounting field.
